questions.OQD-H6: Do elites retain quality on mazes from STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT families (out-of-family transfer), or is GEN-v1 support merely within-family interpolation?
questions.OQD-H7: Do elites retain quality under sensor noise and actuator degradation on the source maze (E5 fault injection)?

platform.note: all conditions measured on THIS platform in one mode; no cross-platform comparison claims

material.package: byte-identical to delivered ZIP (SHA256SUMS 89/89); package code imported, never modified

families.A_open_pillar_arena: NO walls; 7 pillars r~U(0.07,0.10); placement: x,y~U(0.10,0.90), min dist from START 0.18+r, min pillar separation ri+rj+0.06
families.B_vertical_chambers: 3 vertical walls (thickness 0.035) at x~U(0.24,0.34), U(0.50,0.62), U(0.76,0.86); each has one gap of height 0.28; gap y-ranges forced alternating U(0.12,0.35) and U(0.55,0.80); plus 2 pillars r~U(0.06,0.09)
families.C_dense_forest: NO walls; 12 small pillars r~U(0.035,0.055); same placement rules

out_of_family_mazes.selection: for each family, take pool seeds in order until 2 valid mazes per family; ALL candidates (accepted+rejected) logged with reason
validity_rules: START (0.06,0.06) and the 4 x/y 0.02-shifted starts free
free-area ratio within [0.75, 1.15] x source-maze free-area ratio (0.8743)
flood-fill reachable free grid-centers (64x64 from START) >= 0.55 of free centers

fault_injection.mechanism: monkey-patch module constants inside harness context manager ONLY (package files untouched): sensor noise = additive Gaussian on normalized raycast distances, clipped back to [0,1]; actuator degradation = env.V_MAX multiplied by factor (speed authority); turn authority unchanged; noise rng np.random.default_rng(777000+condition_index), fresh per evaluate call, iid draws (NOT paired across archives; archives have different N)
fault_injection.clean_reference: CLEAN condition re-measured in THIS study on the same archives (retention denominators internal to GEN-v2)

baselines.random_per_h6_maze: n=256 fresh genomes N(0,1.2) clip +/-4, rng=np.random.default_rng(2000000+maze_seed), identical for every archive on that maze

hypotheses.claim: Elites retain meaningful quality on out-of-family mazes (generic reactive skill, not source-grammar interpolation).
hypotheses.test_plan: 3 families x 2 mazes x 3 primary archives vs same-maze fresh-random n=256; all pairs reported; mutation archives as robustness (no verdict role).
hypotheses.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED_IN_THIS_LAB if both thresholds met on the overall mean; REJECTED_BY_THRESHOLD if either fails; UNKNOWN on missing pairs. Per-family mean advantage <= 0.05 additionally records the label 'family-bound: <family>' as a negative finding without changing the overall verdict rule.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Overall mean advantage <= 0.05 => archive skill labeled source-grammar-bound; thresholds immutable after observation.

hypotheses.claim: Elites tolerate moderate sensor noise (E5-style fault) on the source maze.
hypotheses.test_plan: Primary condition N10 (sigma=0.10); ladder N05/N20/S75/S50 reported descriptively; 3 primary archives.
hypotheses.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED_IN_THIS_LAB if N10 mean retention >= 0.80; REJECTED_BY_THRESHOLD if < 0.80; UNKNOWN on evaluation failure.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Any single condition mean retention < 0.50 records 'collapse at <condition>' as a negative finding; verdict rule unchanged.

inference_limits: toy 2D point-robot; no real hardware, no market, no OCTOPUS Core
out-of-family is still: same arena, same start corner, same sensors/controller/quality metric
sensor noise modeled as additive Gaussian on normalized distance; actuator fault as speed-authority scaling only
no p-values; descriptive means; negative results preserved verbatim
local SHA-256 receipt chain only, no signature, no external anchor
